ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible surface area comprises approximately 35% high-intensity (white/mottled) pixels and 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large, irregular high-intensity mottled cluster in the proximal-central region. Right lobe is predominantly low-intensity with discrete high-intensity spots localized along the ventral-water interface. Distal regions of both lobes, excluding tips, are primarily low-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible portion of the central notch forms an acute V-shape with an approximate 45-degree angle; the apex is obscured by water splash at the waterline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge featuring approximately 14 distinct serration peaks with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 2 to 8 pixels, more densely concentrated on the outer portions of each lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory extending from the medial notch area towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two dense, high-contrast clusters of circular white pixel groups (barnacle rosettes) localized at the terminal ends of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and resulting localized white scarring at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
